name: Harrier
description: A nimble fighter armed with javelins.

abilities.name: Maintain Distance
abilities.description: After making a standard attack, the Harrier can move anywhere within Far range.

abilities.name: Fall Back
abilities.description: When a creature moves into Melee range to make an attack, you can mark a Stress before the attack roll to move anywhere within Close range and make an attack against that creature. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.
